zara: Quick heads-up: new onboarding bulk-embed sample spikes infra 429s on first run with batch=64 and concurrency=10.

ben: saw that earlier. Is it token quota or concurrent request cap?

zara: concurrency + synchronized retries. We fire 10 requests, edge returns Retry-After ~2s, many clients retry together.

mia: what's the SDK doing for backoff?

zara: node SDK uses small jitter only for chat; bulk endpoints use deterministic exp backoff. Also we don't decrement semaphore by estimated tokens when queuing.

ben: plan: lower sample defaults (concurrency 3, batch 24), add RW_ONBOARD_FAST opt-in. SDK changes: honor Retry-After for bulk, switch to full jitter backoff, subtract estimateTokens at acquire.

mia: add an e2e that fakes rate-limit headers to validate spread.

devx-bot: created DX-1011 "onboard: bulk jitter + semaphore parity" assigned @ben

zara: I'll update quickstart docs and sample repo after SDK PR merges. If anyone repros, run with DEBUG=sdk:throttle and paste logs. :thumbsup:
